terms.p: A variable from the surrounding scope that a closure stores in its generated struct, either as a reference or as an owned value.
The rule since edition 2021 that a closure captures the individual struct fields its body mentions rather than the whole struct.
The type written fn(i32) -> i32, a single word holding the address of some code, with no room for captured variables.
The trait for a closure whose body consumes something it captured, so calling it destroys it.
The trait for a closure whose body changes something it captured, so it needs unique access each call.
The trait for a closure whose body only reads what it captured, so it can be called from several places at once.
